candidate_requirement: Use both current Split-C1 Core-C1 and Display-C1 identities, exact assembly BOMs and firmware build; results from historical integrated C4D, routing142, development kits or another component revision do not transfer.

tests.name: USB-C sink and USB2 compliance
tests.pass_rule: Both CC paths and every tested state comply with the approved USB-C/USB2 test-limit revision; no current assumption above the detected source capability; no latch-up, unsafe reverse current or data failure.

tests.name: Charging, NTC, ship mode and deep-sleep current
tests.pass_rule: All values are within the exact selected cell, SGM41513, CW2217 and approved system limits; NTC faults inhibit charging safely; ship/deep-sleep currents meet the approved product budget; no protection is bypassed.

tests.name: Front-light warm/cool current accuracy
tests.pass_rule: No warm/cool string exceeds 15.0 mA including startup and command extremes; programmed nominal is 14.5 mA; mismatch and optical uniformity satisfy the approved display/product limit.

tests.name: Front-light OVP and open-string behavior
tests.pass_rule: Configured 18 V OVP operates within the approved SGM37601 tolerance, no component or panel terminal exceeds its rated/approved stress, faults are reported and recovery is controlled without repeated unsafe restart.

tests.name: Front-light COUT effective capacitance at DC bias
tests.pass_rule: Measured/supplier-supported effective capacitance and ESR at the actual boost bias and temperature remain above the SGM37601 application minimum with the approved margin; nominal 4.7 uF alone is not sufficient evidence.

tests.name: D905 Schottky high-temperature reverse leakage
tests.pass_rule: Leakage at the actual reverse voltage and approved hot condition stays within the converter/output budget and component guarantee; no thermal runaway or unsafe output behavior.

tests.name: L905 temperature, EMI and audible-noise qualification
tests.pass_rule: Measured peak current remains below the qualified saturation/rated-current margin, temperatures remain below component/enclosure limits, and EMI/acoustic results meet the approved product/regulatory pre-compliance limits.

tests.name: Touch and front-light FPC mechanical/electrical fit
tests.pass_rule: FPC orientation/contact side matches the FT01C drawing, all pins are continuous without shorts, latch/clearance/bend requirements survive the approved insertion cycle count, and touch/front-light functions remain stable.

tests.name: RF, thermal, reading-runtime benchmark and complete EVT soak
tests.pass_rule: RF performance and emissions, all component/enclosure temperatures, concurrent-load stability and the approved soak/regression suite meet the product and applicable regulatory pre-compliance limits with zero unexplained resets or data corruption. Reading runtime and measured battery-terminal energy meet the approved product budget. X4 Pro comparison requires a real identified reference device, matched page workload, measured frontlight output, wireless schedule, temperature and shutdown endpoint; capacity or UI brightness percent alone is not runtime evidence.
blocked_until: selected complete battery pack and approved runtime/current limits
identified physical X4 Pro reference and matched approved comparison protocol

tests.name: Display-C1 EPD power, SPI and full-refresh qualification
accessory_scope: approved host or current Core-C1 fixture
tests.pass_rule: Exact panel-approved voltage/waveform/sequence limits and SSD1677 SPI/BUSY timing are met; L1 peak current stays within approved derated 250mA saturation margin and thermal rating; Q1/D1-D3 and capacitors remain within rated stress. Correct white/black/pattern refresh with traceable waveform and image evidence. No powered insertion, uncontrolled high-voltage restart or host backfeed.
blocked_until: exact FT01C drawing and waveform/initialization profile
registered host firmware and measurement instruments

tests.name: Core-C1 plus Display-C1 mating, enclosure and power-sequence qualification
tests.pass_rule: Current Core J601 socket mates to current Display J1 plug at the documented transform and approved 1.5mm nominal gap tolerance. All60 contacts follow the interface contract, including grounds,35/36 power and reserved NCs. USB shell/stake/solder clearance, independent Display support, full battery pack/NTC harness/swelling and FT01C flex fit meet released maximum dimensions. Startup/sleep/reset/shutdown remain controlled with no signal backfeed and safe port access. RTC backup must retain valid uninterrupted time for at least24h in every declared room/cold/hot state with the main supplies physically isolated; measured duration and end voltage are required.
blocked_until: both assembled current boards registered as one serial pair
maximum-dimension mechanical drawing for enclosure/battery/FT01C flex
exact domestic RTC/backup assembly and reviewed no-charge or charge circuit
approved backup temperature, source age/initial-charge and ending-voltage limits

rtc_backup_protocol.test_setup: Disconnect USB,main battery,debugger;prevent GPIO/I2C/INT backfeed. R303/R304 removed. SD3078+C301 rechargeable cap,18H=0x82 every boot;precharge preliminary6h but measure initialVBAT>=3.15V. Log total backup current,temperatures,time/flags,end voltage. No primary cells on charged node.
rtc_backup_protocol.corner_policy: Approved limits must define temperature, cell shelf-age or minimum capacitor charge and allowed final backup voltage; no guaranteed corners are invented here.

prototype_engineering_targets.approval_required: Actual operating/temperature/age/charge/voltage limits after prototype evidence;do not widen cap -25..70C range

runtime_benchmark_protocol.numeric_runtime_limit_status: No official reproducible duration; product limits must be approved using a matched reference measurement.
reference_device_registration: charger/charge termination and normal shutdown endpoint

proposed_common_conditions.document: same fixed, hashed text workload; match visible text size and content
proposed_common_conditions.frontlight_on: match measured white-page luminance and warm/cool mode; target luminance pending approval
proposed_common_conditions.wireless: radios off for baseline; separately define and log identical sync schedule
proposed_common_conditions.start_end: manufacturer-normal full charge to normal firmware shutdown; never bypass cell protection

required_raw_records: whole-battery current/voltage time series including sleep
runtime_benchmark_protocol.comparability_rule: UI brightness percentages and equal mAh do not establish equal runtime. Report unmatched reference conditions explicitly; do not label an unmatched result as reference-equivalent.
runtime_benchmark_protocol.scope: Reading mode comparison; full WiFi/BLE/audio/concurrent-load qualification remains separate within Q12.

physical_test_status_reason: User confirmed no real Core-C1 or Display-C1 boards exist yet; this is a future EVT plan, not a failed physical test campaign.
sample_pair_requirement: Register Core and Display serials, both PCB hashes, both assembly BOMs and firmware; independently test each PCB before unpowered mating, then test the pair. Never mate/unmate under power.
